name: Barbell Bench Press

setup: Lie flat on the bench with feet firmly on the floor.
Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Retract your shoulder blades and maintain a slight arch in your lower back.
action: Lower the bar in a controlled manner to your mid-chest.
Keep elbows at a 45-75 degree angle to your torso.
Press the bar back up explosively to the starting position.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "Push yourself away from the bar, not the bar away from you."

commonMistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.

name: Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press

setup: Same setup as Barbell Bench Press, but with a shoulder-width grip.
Keep shoulder blades retracted.
action: Lower the bar towards your lower chest, keeping elbows tucked close to your body.
Press upwards, focusing on triceps contraction.

commonMistakes: Using too wide a grip, negating the triceps focus.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press

setup: Sit on the bench with dumbbells resting on your thighs.
Kick the dumbbells up to your chest as you lie back.
action: Press the dumbbells upwards until arms are fully extended.
Lower them slowly and with control, allowing for a deeper stretch than a barbell.

commonMistakes: Clanging the dumbbells together at the top.

name: Push-up

setup: Place hands slightly wider than shoulder-width on the floor.
Form a straight line from your head to your heels.
Engage your core and glutes.
action: Lower your body until your chest nearly touches the floor.
Keep your elbows from flaring out excessively.
Push back up to the starting position.

commonMistakes: Not achieving full range of motion.

name: Incline Push-up

setup: Place hands on an elevated surface like a bench or box.
The higher the surface, the easier the exercise.
Maintain a straight body line.
action: Lower your chest to the surface.
Push back up powerfully.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "Brace your core like you're about to be punched."

commonMistakes: Bending at the waist instead of moving the whole body.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press

setup: Set a bench to a 30-45 degree incline.
Sit and bring dumbbells to your chest.
action: Press the dumbbells up and slightly inwards.
Lower with control, feeling a stretch in the upper chest.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "Press towards the ceiling, not just straight up."

commonMistakes: Using too steep an incline, turning it into a shoulder press.

name: Incline Barbell Press

setup: Set a bench to a 30-45 degree incline within a rack.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
action: Unrack the bar and lower it to your upper chest.
Drive the bar up forcefully.

commonMistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.

name: Dumbbell Flye

setup: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells pressed over your chest, palms facing each other.
Slight bend in the elbows.
action: Lower the dumbbells out to your sides in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest to bring the weights back to the start.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "Imagine you are hugging a giant tree."

commonMistakes: Bending elbows too much, turning it into a press.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row

setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip.
Hinge at your hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Keep your back straight.
action: Pull the bar towards your lower chest / upper abdomen.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the bar with control.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "Pull with your elbows, not your hands."

commonMistakes: Using body English to lift the weight.

name: Dumbbell Row

setup: Place one knee and one hand on a flat bench.
Hold a dumbbell in the opposite hand with a neutral grip.
Keep your back flat and parallel to the ground.
action: Pull the dumbbell up towards your hip.
Focus on squeezing your lat.
Lower with control.

commonMistakes: Twisting the torso to lift the weight.

setup: Sit at a cable station with feet on the platform.
Grab the handle with your desired grip (e.g., V-bar).
Sit upright with your chest out.
action: Pull the handle towards your abdomen.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Slowly return to the starting position.

name: Pull-up

setup: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than your shoulders.
action: Pull your chest towards the bar.
Drive your elbows down and back.
Lower yourself with control until your arms are straight.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "Try to break the bar in half."

commonMistakes: Not using a full range of motion.

setup: Attach weight using a dip belt or by holding a dumbbell between your feet.
Grab the bar as you would for a regular pull-up.
action: Perform a pull-up with the added resistance, maintaining strict form.

setup: Adjust the knee pad to lock your legs in place.
Grab the bar with a wide grip.
action: Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats and keep your torso stationary.
Return slowly to the start.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "Pull with your back, not your arms."

setup: Set a barbell in a squat rack at waist height.
Lie underneath it and grab the bar with a shoulder-width grip.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
action: Pull your chest towards the bar.
Lower yourself with control.

setup: Set the bar in a rack at shoulder height.
Place the bar on your upper back/traps, not your neck.
Grip the bar firmly and unrack it.
action: Take 2-3 steps back. Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Brace your core, then descend by breaking at the hips and knees simultaneously.
Keep your chest up and back straight. Go to at least parallel depth.
Drive through your heels to return to standing.

setup: Hold one end of a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Feet shoulder-width apart.
action: Squat down between your legs, keeping your torso upright.
The weight acts as a counterbalance, making it easier to maintain good form.
Drive up to the start.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "Keep the weight glued to your chest."

name: Bodyweight Squat

setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend arms in front of you for balance.
action: Descend as if sitting in a chair.
Keep your back straight and chest up.
Rise back to the starting position.

commonMistakes: Letting knees travel too far past toes.

name: Leg Press

setup: Sit in the machine and place your feet on the platform.
Release the safety catches.
action: Lower the platform by bending your knees.
Press the weight back up, but do not lock out your knees at the top.

commonMistakes: Using a limited range of motion.
Letting the lower back round off the pad.

name: Lunge

setup: Stand with feet together.
action: Take a large step forward with one leg.
Lower your hips until both knees are bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push off the front foot to return to the start.

commonMistakes: Front knee extending past the ankle.

name: Barbell Deadlift

setup: Stand with your mid-foot under the barbell.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip the bar.
Keep your back straight, chest up, and shoulders back.
action: Drive through your legs to lift the weight.
Keep the bar close to your body.
Stand up tall, pulling your shoulders back at the top.
Lower the bar with control by hinging at the hips first.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "Push the world away with your feet."

commonMistakes: Jerking the weight off the floor.

name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)

setup: Stand tall holding a barbell.
Keep a slight bend in your knees throughout the movement.
action: Hinge at your hips, pushing your butt back.
Lower the bar while keeping it close to your legs.
Go as low as you can without rounding your back.
Squeeze your glutes to return to the standing position.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "Imagine closing a car door with your butt."

commonMistakes: Bending the knees too much, turning it into a squat.

name: Kettlebell Swing

setup: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Place the kettlebell about a foot in front of you.
action: Hinge and grab the kettlebell with both hands.
Hike it back between your legs like a football.
Explosively thrust your hips forward, letting the kettlebell swing up to chest height.
Let gravity bring it back down and repeat in a fluid motion.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "This is a hip hinge, not a squat. It's an explosive movement."

commonMistakes: Using arms to lift the kettlebell.

name: Overhead Press (Barbell)

setup: Set the bar in a rack at chest height.
Grip the bar just outside your shoulders.
Keep elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Brace your core and glutes.
action: Press the bar straight overhead.
Push your head slightly through at the top to align the bar over your spine.
Lower with control to the starting position.

commonMistakes: Not using a full range of motion.

name: Seated Dumbbell Press

setup: Sit on a bench with back support.
Bring dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
action: Press the dumbbells overhead until they almost touch.
Lower them with control.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "Control the weight, don't let it control you."

commonMistakes: Arching the back excessively off the pad.

name: Lateral Raise

setup: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides with a neutral grip.
action: Raise the dumbbells out to your sides with a slight bend in your elbows.
Lift until your arms are parallel to the floor.
Lower with control.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "Pour a jug of water at the top of the movement."

commonMistakes: Using momentum or 'shrugging' the weight up.

name: Barbell Curl

setup: Hold a barbell with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
action: Curl the bar upwards towards your shoulders.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower with control.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "Imagine your elbows are fixed on a pivot."

commonMistakes: Swinging the back to lift the weight.

setup: Stand or sit holding dumbbells at your sides, palms facing forward (or neutral).
action: Curl the weights up, one at a time or simultaneously.
Optionally, supinate (twist) your wrist as you lift.
Lower with control.

name: Chin-up

setup: Grab a pull-up bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
action: Pull your chest towards the bar.
Lower yourself with control.

commonMistakes: Not using a full range of motion.

setup: Attach a rope or bar to a high-pulley cable.
Grip the attachment with elbows tucked at your sides.
action: Press the attachment down until your arms are fully extended.
Focus on triceps contraction.
Allow the weight to come back up with control.

name: Dips (Triceps Version)

setup: Use parallel bars.
Keep your torso as upright as possible to target the triceps.
action: Lower your body by bending your elbows.
Press back up to the starting position.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "Scrape your back against an imaginary wall."

commonMistakes: Leaning too far forward, which targets the chest more.

name: Bench Dips

setup: Sit on the edge of a bench and place your hands on the edge beside your hips.
Extend your legs out in front of you.
action: Slide your hips off the bench and lower your body.
Push back up with your triceps.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "Keep your back close to the bench."

commonMistakes: Going too low, which can stress the shoulders.

name: Plank

setup: Lie on your stomach and prop yourself up on your forearms and toes.
action: Form a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and glutes.
Hold for time.

commonMistakes: Hips too high or too low.

name: Hanging Leg Raise

setup: Hang from a pull-up bar.
action: Raise your legs up as high as you can without swinging.
Lower with control.

commonMistakes: Using momentum to swing the legs up.

setup: Hang from a pull-up bar or use a captain's chair.
action: Raise your knees towards your chest.
Lower with control.

setup: Stand on the edge of a step or platform.
Hold onto something for balance.
action: Lower your heels to feel a stretch.
Press up onto the balls of your feet as high as possible.
Squeeze at the top.
executionCues.keyMentalCues: "Pause at the top and bottom of the movement."

setup: Sit and rest your forearm on your thigh, palm up.
action: Let the dumbbell roll down to your fingertips.
Curl your wrist up to lift the weight.
